label: POSITIVE
name: Positive reaction pattern
description: Strong reddish-purple colour shift consistent with a positive presumptive reaction for this reagent.

label: NEGATIVE
name: Negative / no-reaction pattern
description: Neutral tone with little to no colour shift from the unreacted reagent baseline.

label: INCONCLUSIVE
name: Ambiguous / weak reaction pattern
description: Faint, mixed, or unusual colour shift that does not clearly match a known reaction pattern.
